user.title: blaulichtSMS Alarm API
user.description: Enter the credentials of the automatic alarm trigger configured for your customer id on start.blaulichtsms.net. This is a separate user of its own: neither your dashboard login nor your normal portal login works here. The credentials are verified with a read-only request; no alarm is triggered.

groups.title: Alarm group filter
groups.description: Optional: restrict which alarm groups may be alerted. The groups of the recent alarms are offered for selection; the API cannot list all configured groups, so a group that was not alerted lately can simply be typed in. If a filter is set, every service call must name its groups explicitly and only these groups are accepted. Leave empty to allow all groups.

reauth_confirm.description: Your credentials are no longer valid. Please enter them again.

reconfigure.description: Update the username and password of the automatic alarm trigger.
